title: Appeals and Grievances Amount-in-Dispute Rule
content:
Amount in dispute on Appeals and Grievances cases — rule text with retirements marked.

1. *Retired — no longer in force:* "The amount in dispute is figured under the tier's amount-in-dispute basis". This clause is no longer in force; the current basis governs.
2. *Retired — no longer in force:* "for a claim line, the TRICARE payment denied plus the beneficiary liability at issue on the line". This clause is no longer in force; the current basis governs.
3. *Retired — no longer in force:* "for an authorization, the allowed amount of the services requested as estimated on the request". This clause is no longer in force; the current basis governs.
4. *In force:* for an enrollment, the amount in dispute is zero.
5. *In force:* for a grievance, the amount in dispute is zero.
6. *In force:* amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount are never in dispute.

| Subject | Amount in dispute under the clauses in force |
|---|---|
| an enrollment | zero |
| a grievance | zero |
| any subject, for amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount | never in dispute |

superseded_clauses: for a claim line, the TRICARE payment denied plus the beneficiary liability at issue on the line
for an authorization, the allowed amount of the services requested as estimated on the request
